common_clinical_use: Prevention/treatment of thrombosis, stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation
interaction_mechanism: VKORC1 promoter variant reduces vitamin K epoxide reductase expression (drug target sensitivity); CYP2C9*3 reduces hepatic clearance of active S-warfarin
cpic_recommendation_summary: Use a validated pharmacogenomic dosing algorithm (e.g. WarfarinDosing.org) combining VKORC1 + CYP2C9 genotype; typically requires 30-50% lower starting dose in variant carriers
alternative_options: Direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) e.g. apixaban/rivaroxaban if not otherwise contraindicated
risk_level: High - bleeding risk if not dose-adjusted

interaction_mechanism: CYP2C9*3 reduces hepatic metabolism leading to drug accumulation
cpic_recommendation_summary: CPIC recommends reduced starting dose and more frequent therapeutic drug monitoring for CYP2C9 poor metabolizers
risk_level: Moderate - risk of toxicity (nystagmus/ataxia) at standard dose

interaction_mechanism: Reduced clearance in CYP2C9 poor metabolizers increases systemic exposure
cpic_recommendation_summary: CPIC recommends starting at the lowest approved dose in poor metabolizers with close monitoring
risk_level: Moderate - increased GI/CV adverse effect exposure

common_clinical_use: Prevention of thrombosis after PCI/stenting, ACS, stroke
interaction_mechanism: CYP2C19*2 (loss of function) impairs conversion of prodrug to active metabolite, reducing antiplatelet effect; CYP2C19*17 (gain of function) increases active metabolite, raising bleeding risk
cpic_recommendation_summary: CPIC recommends an alternative antiplatelet (prasugrel/ticagrelor) for *2 poor/intermediate metabolizers if PCI indicated; standard dosing generally acceptable for *17 rapid metabolizers with bleeding-risk awareness
risk_level: High - reduced efficacy risks stent thrombosis in poor metabolizers

standard_reference_dose: Loading 6 mg/kg BID, then 4 mg/kg BID
cpic_recommendation_summary: CPIC recommends alternative agent or therapeutic drug monitoring-guided dosing in poor and rapid/ultrarapid metabolizers
risk_level: Moderate - toxicity risk (poor metabolizers) or treatment failure (ultrarapid)

interaction_mechanism: Poor metabolizers accumulate drug (QT prolongation risk); ultrarapid metabolizers may be subtherapeutic

cpic_recommendation_summary: CPIC recommends avoiding high-dose simvastatin in SLCO1B1 decreased-function carriers; consider alternative statin or lower dose with monitoring

alternative_options: Morphine or non-opioid analgesics (bypass CYP2D6 activation step)
